blocks.prompt: 1 (i) Without using table find the value of \(\sin 15^{\circ}\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh "table ke baghair value" wala sawal hai. 15 degree koi special angle nahi jis ki value hum zubani jaante hon.
Humein \(\sin 15^{\circ}\) ki exact value surd (jazar wali shakal) mein chahiye.
Plan: hint ke mutabiq \(15^{\circ} = 45^{\circ} - 30^{\circ}\) likhenge aur \(\sin(\alpha - \beta)\) ka formula lagayenge.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: angle \(15^{\circ}\).
Humein find karna hai: \(\sin 15^{\circ}\), table ke baghair.
Tareeqa: \(15^{\circ} = 45^{\circ} - 30^{\circ}\) likh kar yeh formula lagayenge:
\[\sin(\alpha - \beta) = \sin\alpha\cos\beta - \cos\alpha\sin\beta\]
Yeh formula is liye munasib hai ke is ke right side par sirf 45 aur 30 ke sine aur cosine aate hain, jo humein pehle se maloom hain. Yani ek anjaan value ko chaar maloom values mein badal diya.

Zaroori values yaad karein
\[\sin 45^{\circ} = \cos 45^{\circ} = \dfrac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\]
\[\sin 30^{\circ} = \dfrac{1}{2},\ \cos 30^{\circ} = \dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\]
Kyun: Yeh special angles hain jin ki values hum 30-60-90 aur 45-45-90 wale triangles se jaante hain. Isi liye table ki zaroorat nahi parti; sawal ka matlab hi yeh hai ke hum 15 ko inhi do angles mein tod dein.

Difference formula lagayein
\[\sin 15^{\circ} = \sin(45^{\circ} - 30^{\circ})\]
\[= \sin 45^{\circ}\cos 30^{\circ} - \cos 45^{\circ}\sin 30^{\circ}\]
Kyun: Formula mein \(\alpha = 45^{\circ}\) aur \(\beta = 30^{\circ}\) rakha. Sine ke formula mein pattern yaad rakhein: \"sin cos, cos sin\", aur beech ka sign wohi jo angle mein hai (yahan minus).
Dhyan dein: \(\sin(45^{\circ} - 30^{\circ})\) ko \(\sin 45^{\circ} - \sin 30^{\circ}\) likhna bohat aam ghalti hai; sine angles par is tarah \"distribute\" nahi hota.

Values rakh kar hal karein
\[= \dfrac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\cdot\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2} - \dfrac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\cdot\dfrac{1}{2}\]
\[= \dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2\sqrt{2}} - \dfrac{1}{2\sqrt{2}}\]
\[= \dfrac{\sqrt{3} - 1}{2\sqrt{2}}\]
Kyun: Dono products ka denominator \(2\sqrt{2}\) ek hi hai, is liye seedha numerators ko minus kar diya. Fractions multiply karte waqt upar wale upar aur neeche wale neeche multiply hote hain.

Tasdeeq
\[\dfrac{\sqrt{3} - 1}{2\sqrt{2}} \approx \dfrac{0.732}{2.828} \approx 0.2588\]
Kyun: Calculator par \(\sin 15^{\circ} \approx 0.2588\) hi aata hai. Waise bhi chhote acute angle ka sine chhota aur positive hota hai, aur hamara jawab bhi aisa hi hai, is liye hum mutmain hain.

blocks.prompt: 1 (ii) Without using table find the value of \(\cos 15^{\circ}\).
blocks.explanation:
Bilkul part (i) jaisa sawal hai, bas ab cosine chahiye.
Humein \(\cos 15^{\circ}\) ki exact value nikalni hai.
Plan: phir se \(15^{\circ} = 45^{\circ} - 30^{\circ}\), lekin is dafa \(\cos(\alpha - \beta)\) ka formula.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: angle \(15^{\circ}\).
Humein find karna hai: \(\cos 15^{\circ}\).
Tareeqa: \(15^{\circ} = 45^{\circ} - 30^{\circ}\) aur yeh formula:
\[\cos(\alpha - \beta) = \cos\alpha\cos\beta + \sin\alpha\sin\beta\]
Yeh wohi fundamental law of trigonometry hai jo is unit ki buniyaad hai; baqi saare formulas isi se nikle hain.

Zaroori values yaad karein
\[\sin 45^{\circ} = \cos 45^{\circ} = \dfrac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\]
\[\sin 30^{\circ} = \dfrac{1}{2},\ \cos 30^{\circ} = \dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\]
Kyun: Yeh special angles hain jin ki values hum 30-60-90 aur 45-45-90 wale triangles se jaante hain. Isi liye table ki zaroorat nahi parti; sawal ka matlab hi yeh hai ke hum 15 ko inhi do angles mein tod dein.

Formula lagayein
\[\cos 15^{\circ} = \cos(45^{\circ} - 30^{\circ})\]
\[= \cos 45^{\circ}\cos 30^{\circ} + \sin 45^{\circ}\sin 30^{\circ}\]
Kyun: Cosine ke formula ka pattern \"cos cos, sin sin\" hai, aur sign ulat jata hai: angle mein minus ho to beech mein plus aata hai.
Dhyan dein: Students aksar sine wala pattern yahan bhi laga dete hain ya sign ulatna bhool jate hain. Yaad rakhne ka tareeqa: cosine \"ulta chalta hai\".

Values rakhein
\[= \dfrac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\cdot\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2} + \dfrac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\cdot\dfrac{1}{2}\]
\[= \dfrac{\sqrt{3} + 1}{2\sqrt{2}}\]
Kyun: Dono terms ka denominator \(2\sqrt{2}\) hai, to numerators jama kar diye. Notice karein ke part (i) ke jawab se sirf beech ka sign mukhtalif hai.

Tasdeeq
\[\sin^2 15^{\circ} + \cos^2 15^{\circ} = \dfrac{(\sqrt{3} - 1)^2 + (\sqrt{3} + 1)^2}{8}\]
\[= \dfrac{(4 - 2\sqrt{3}) + (4 + 2\sqrt{3})}{8} = 1 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Ek hi angle ke sine aur cosine ke squares ka jama hamesha 1 hota hai. Part (i) aur part (ii) ke jawab is test mein pass ho gaye, to dono sahi hain.

blocks.prompt: 1 (iii) Without using table find the value of \(\tan 15^{\circ}\).
blocks.explanation:
Ab tangent ki baari hai, angle wohi 15 degree.
Humein \(\tan 15^{\circ}\) ki exact value chahiye.
Plan: \(\tan(\alpha - \beta)\) ka formula 45 aur 30 ke saath; doosra raasta yeh ke part (i) ko part (ii) se divide kar dein. Dono se ek hi jawab aana chahiye.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: angle \(15^{\circ}\).
Humein find karna hai: \(\tan 15^{\circ}\).
Tareeqa:
\[\tan(\alpha - \beta) = \dfrac{\tan\alpha - \tan\beta}{1 + \tan\alpha\tan\beta}\]
Yahan \(\tan 45^{\circ} = 1\) aur \(\tan 30^{\circ} = \dfrac{1}{\sqrt{3}}\) hain. Tangent formula mein numerator mein angle wala sign, aur denominator mein ulta sign aata hai.

Formula lagayein
\[\tan 15^{\circ} = \dfrac{\tan 45^{\circ} - \tan 30^{\circ}}{1 + \tan 45^{\circ}\tan 30^{\circ}}\]
\[= \dfrac{1 - \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}}{1 + \frac{1}{\sqrt{3}}}\]
Kyun: \(\alpha = 45^{\circ}\) aur \(\beta = 30^{\circ}\) rakhe. \(\tan 45^{\circ} = 1\) hone ki wajah se formula bohat halka ho jata hai, isi liye 45 wala tod sab se aasaan hai.

Chhoti fractions khatam karein
\[= \dfrac{\sqrt{3} - 1}{\sqrt{3} + 1}\]
Kyun: Upar aur neeche dono ko \(\sqrt{3}\) se multiply kiya. Kisi fraction ke numerator aur denominator ko ek hi number se multiply karne se us ki value nahi badalti, sirf shakal saaf ho jati hai. Book ka answer key bhi isi shakal mein hai.

Mazeed simplify (agar chahein)
\[= \dfrac{(\sqrt{3} - 1)^2}{(\sqrt{3} + 1)(\sqrt{3} - 1)}\]
\[= \dfrac{4 - 2\sqrt{3}}{2} = 2 - \sqrt{3}\]
Kyun: Denominator ko rationalise kiya, yani us ke conjugate (ulte sign wale saathi) \(\sqrt{3} - 1\) se multiply kiya taake neeche \(3 - 1 = 2\) reh jaye. Dono shaklein sahi hain; exam mein koi bhi likh sakte hain.

Tasdeeq
\[\dfrac{\sin 15^{\circ}}{\cos 15^{\circ}} = \dfrac{\sqrt{3} - 1}{2\sqrt{2}} \div \dfrac{\sqrt{3} + 1}{2\sqrt{2}}\]
\[= \dfrac{\sqrt{3} - 1}{\sqrt{3} + 1} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Tangent hamesha sine divided by cosine hota hai. Parts (i) aur (ii) se bhi wohi jawab aaya, aur \(2 - \sqrt{3} \approx 0.268\) calculator se bhi milta hai.

blocks.prompt: 1 (iv) Without using table find the value of \(\sin 105^{\circ}\).
blocks.explanation:
105 degree bhi special angle nahi, lekin hint batata hai ke \(105^{\circ} = 60^{\circ} + 45^{\circ}\).
Humein \(\sin 105^{\circ}\) ki exact value chahiye.
Plan: is dafa angles jama ho rahe hain, is liye \(\sin(\alpha + \beta)\) ka formula.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: angle \(105^{\circ}\).
Humein find karna hai: \(\sin 105^{\circ}\).
Tareeqa: \(105^{\circ} = 60^{\circ} + 45^{\circ}\) aur:
\[\sin(\alpha + \beta) = \sin\alpha\cos\beta + \cos\alpha\sin\beta\]
Kyun yahi tod? Kyunke 60 aur 45 dono special angles hain; 90 + 15 bhi likh sakte the, lekin phir 15 ki value pehle nikalni parti.

Zaroori values yaad karein
\[\sin 60^{\circ} = \dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2},\ \cos 60^{\circ} = \dfrac{1}{2}\]
\[\sin 45^{\circ} = \cos 45^{\circ} = \dfrac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\]
Kyun: 105 koi special angle nahi, lekin 60 aur 45 dono special hain aur in ka jama 105 banta hai. Bas inhi chaar values se poora kaam ho jayega.

Formula lagayein
\[\sin 105^{\circ} = \sin(60^{\circ} + 45^{\circ})\]
\[= \sin 60^{\circ}\cos 45^{\circ} + \cos 60^{\circ}\sin 45^{\circ}\]
Kyun: \(\alpha = 60^{\circ}\), \(\beta = 45^{\circ}\). Sine ke formula mein angle ka sign hi beech mein aata hai, to yahan plus.

Values rakhein
\[= \dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\cdot\dfrac{1}{\sqrt{2}} + \dfrac{1}{2}\cdot\dfrac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\]
\[= \dfrac{\sqrt{3} + 1}{2\sqrt{2}}\]
Kyun: Dono products ka denominator \(2\sqrt{2}\) hai, numerators jama kar diye.
Dhyan dein: \(\sin 60^{\circ}\) aur \(\cos 60^{\circ}\) ko aapas mein badal dena aam ghalti hai; yaad rakhein \(\sin 60^{\circ}\) bara hai (\(\sqrt{3}/2\)) kyunke 60 bara angle hai.

Tasdeeq
\[\sin 105^{\circ} = \sin(180^{\circ} - 75^{\circ})\]
\[= \sin 75^{\circ} = \cos 15^{\circ}\]
Kyun: Allied angles ke rule se \(\sin(180^{\circ} - \theta) = \sin\theta\), aur \(\sin 75^{\circ} = \cos 15^{\circ}\) (co-ratio). Part (ii) ka jawab bhi \(\dfrac{\sqrt{3} + 1}{2\sqrt{2}}\) tha, to dono raaston se ek hi jawab aaya \(\checkmark\).

blocks.prompt: 1 (v) Without using table find the value of \(\cos 105^{\circ}\).
blocks.explanation:
Ab \(105^{\circ} = 60^{\circ} + 45^{\circ}\) ka cosine chahiye.
105 degree quadrant II mein hai jahan cosine negative hota hai, is liye hum pehle se umeed rakhte hain ke jawab negative aayega.
Plan: \(\cos(\alpha + \beta)\) ka formula.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: angle \(105^{\circ}\).
Humein find karna hai: \(\cos 105^{\circ}\).
Tareeqa:
\[\cos(\alpha + \beta) = \cos\alpha\cos\beta - \sin\alpha\sin\beta\]
jahan \(\alpha = 60^{\circ}\), \(\beta = 45^{\circ}\). Jawab ka sign pehle se andaza laga lena achhi aadat hai; is se aakhir mein ghalti pakarna aasaan hota hai.

Zaroori values yaad karein
\[\sin 60^{\circ} = \dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2},\ \cos 60^{\circ} = \dfrac{1}{2}\]
\[\sin 45^{\circ} = \cos 45^{\circ} = \dfrac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\]
Kyun: 105 koi special angle nahi, lekin 60 aur 45 dono special hain aur in ka jama 105 banta hai. Bas inhi chaar values se poora kaam ho jayega.

Formula lagayein
\[\cos 105^{\circ} = \cos 60^{\circ}\cos 45^{\circ} - \sin 60^{\circ}\sin 45^{\circ}\]
Kyun: Cosine mein sign ulat jata hai: angle mein plus ho to beech mein minus.
Dhyan dein: Yahi woh jagah hai jahan sab se zyada ghaltiyan hoti hain. Agar plus likh diya to jawab positive aayega, jo quadrant II ke liye na-mumkin hai.

Values rakhein
\[= \dfrac{1}{2}\cdot\dfrac{1}{\sqrt{2}} - \dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\cdot\dfrac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\]
\[= \dfrac{1 - \sqrt{3}}{2\sqrt{2}}\]
Kyun: Denominator ek jaisa hai, numerators ko minus kar diya. Book ka answer key bhi isi shakal mein deta hai.

Tasdeeq
\[1 - \sqrt{3} < 0\]
\[\cos 105^{\circ} \approx \dfrac{-0.732}{2.828} \approx -0.2588\]
Kyun: Jawab negative aaya, jaisa quadrant II mein hona chahiye tha. Aur \(\cos(90^{\circ} + 15^{\circ}) = -\sin 15^{\circ}\) hota hai; part (i) se \(\sin 15^{\circ} \approx 0.2588\), to yeh bhi mil gaya.

blocks.prompt: 1 (vi) Without using table find the value of \(\tan 105^{\circ}\).
blocks.explanation:
Aakhri part: \(\tan 105^{\circ}\). Quadrant II mein tangent negative hota hai, to jawab negative hona chahiye.
Plan: \(\tan(\alpha + \beta)\) ka formula 60 aur 45 ke saath, phir parts (iv) aur (v) se tasdeeq.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: angle \(105^{\circ}\).
Humein find karna hai: \(\tan 105^{\circ}\).
Tareeqa:
\[\tan(\alpha + \beta) = \dfrac{\tan\alpha + \tan\beta}{1 - \tan\alpha\tan\beta}\]
jahan \(\tan 60^{\circ} = \sqrt{3}\) aur \(\tan 45^{\circ} = 1\). Upar angle wala sign (plus), neeche ulta sign (minus).

Formula lagayein
\[\tan 105^{\circ} = \dfrac{\tan 60^{\circ} + \tan 45^{\circ}}{1 - \tan 60^{\circ}\tan 45^{\circ}}\]
\[= \dfrac{\sqrt{3} + 1}{1 - \sqrt{3}}\]
Kyun: \(\alpha = 60^{\circ}\), \(\beta = 45^{\circ}\) rakhe. \(\tan 45^{\circ} = 1\) se multiply karne par kuch nahi badalta, is liye neeche sirf \(1 - \sqrt{3}\) bacha.

Mazeed simplify (agar chahein)
\[= \dfrac{(\sqrt{3} + 1)(1 + \sqrt{3})}{(1 - \sqrt{3})(1 + \sqrt{3})}\]
\[= \dfrac{4 + 2\sqrt{3}}{-2} = -(2 + \sqrt{3})\]
Kyun: Denominator ko rationalise kiya: \((1 - \sqrt{3})(1 + \sqrt{3}) = 1 - 3 = -2\). Upar \((\sqrt{3} + 1)^2 = 3 + 2\sqrt{3} + 1 = 4 + 2\sqrt{3}\). Phir \(-2\) se divide kiya.
Dhyan dein: Neeche negative number aane se poora jawab negative ho jata hai; yeh sign mat bhoolein.

Tasdeeq
\[\dfrac{\sin 105^{\circ}}{\cos 105^{\circ}} = \dfrac{\sqrt{3} + 1}{2\sqrt{2}} \div \dfrac{1 - \sqrt{3}}{2\sqrt{2}}\]
\[= \dfrac{\sqrt{3} + 1}{1 - \sqrt{3}} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Parts (iv) aur (v) ko divide karne se bhi yahi aaya. Value taqreeban \(-3.732\) hai, yani negative, jaisa quadrant II mein hona chahiye.
